title: Record Branchwell results by case
summary: Use the existing Branchwell plan to bind each executed case to a pinned consumer checkout. Keep the browser check's manual observation distinct from automated outcomes.
benefits: Maintainers can tell which behaviors the Branchwell checkout actually exercised.
risks: A green Lydite plan job or a generic consumer build cannot establish the five planned case outcomes.

evidence.claim: The Lydite plan specifies four automated cases and one manual browser case.
